name: Guneku Education & Scholarship Day 2026
tagline: Opening Doors. Creating Opportunities. Building Brighter Futures.
badge: Education for All — empowering our youth, developing our community
sourceNote: Programme details transcribed from the official Guneku Education & Scholarship Day 2026 flyer supplied by Marcel on 2026-09-01. The contact number below is the CORRECTED authoritative number and deliberately differs from the number printed on that flyer version — see contact.correction.
summary: As a community, we believe that every young person deserves the chance to learn, grow and build a better future. Guneku Education & Scholarship Day 2026 is our Back-to-School initiative to support deserving students with real opportunities for professional training and university education.

video.title: Guneku Education & Scholarship Day 2026
video.publishedTitleOnYouTube: ST THIERRY UNIVERSITY VISITS GUNEKU MEDPHISATG, His Royal Highness SCHOLARSHIPS 2026/2027
video.descriptionNote: No description or transcript is recorded here. None was supplied, and none has been written from the video content.

dates.name: Guneku Education & Scholarship Information Day
points: Get information on registration for the scholarship examination
Discuss suitable options for your future
dates.note: Parents are encouraged to attend with their children. No examination is written on 29 August.

dates.name: Scholarship Selection Examination
points: Candidates who wish to sit for the scholarship selection examination are strongly encouraged to register in advance.
dates.note: Advance registration helps us organise properly and ensures your participation.

target.headline: Our target: 50 scholarships
target.summary: We aim to select 50 deserving students for an initial one year of scholarship support.

types.name: Full scholarships
types.description: The successful candidate pays no tuition fees for one academic year.

types.name: Partial scholarships
types.description: Substantial financial assistance that significantly reduces the cost of education.

target.terms: The scholarship is initially awarded for one academic year, with a possibility of extension beyond the first year, depending on academic performance, continued eligibility, programme requirements and available funding.
target.closing: For many young people, even one year of support can be the decisive difference between giving up and moving forward.

openToAll.heading: This opportunity is open to all
openToAll.body: Although this initiative is based in Guneku, young people from Momo Division, neighbouring divisions, the Northwest Region and other parts of Cameroon are warmly encouraged to participate.
openToAll.emphasis: What matters is your motivation, potential, seriousness and willingness to make good use of this opportunity.
openToAll.specialConsideration: Special consideration will be given to young people from the Muslim community and other underserved communities where access to formal education has historically been limited.
openToAll.displaced: Students and families displaced from the crisis-affected Northwest Region and now living in the Southwest, Littoral, Centre, West and other regions are particularly encouraged to take note. This may be an opportunity to come closer to home and access quality education free of charge or at substantially reduced cost.

pathways.name: Career-Oriented Professional Courses
pathways.description: Build skills for specific careers and industries.

pathways.name: University Education
pathways.description: Pathways to degrees and higher education.

pathways.description: Helping you choose the right path.
